Ava Richardson  
Email: avarichardson@email.com | Phone: +44 7700 900123 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/avarichardson | GitHub: github.com/avarichardson  

Ava Richardson is a data engineering professional with five years of experience in building scalable data infrastructure for high-traffic gaming environments. Her career has been defined by designing systems that balance real-time analytics with long-term data governance, enabling teams to derive actionable insights from complex telemetry streams. With a focus on cloud-native architectures and distributed systems, she has contributed to the evolution of data platforms that support millions of active users across multiple platforms. Her work emphasizes reliability, maintainability, and the seamless integration of data pipelines into existing workflows, ensuring that technical solutions align with business objectives.  

At NextGen Interactive, Ava leads the development of cloud-native data platforms that aggregate cross-platform gaming analytics. Her responsibilities include architecting systems that handle terabytes of telemetry data daily, optimizing query performance through schema design, and mentoring junior engineers in best practices for distributed data processing. She has spearheaded the migration of legacy data workflows to modern cloud infrastructures, reducing latency by 40% in critical reporting pipelines. Her work has also involved integrating real-time dashboards that provide insights into player behavior, enabling data-driven decisions on game balancing and monetization strategies. Prior to this, she spent three years at GameCraft Solutions, where she designed ETL pipelines for live game telemetry data using Apache Spark and Snowflake, ensuring data was available for analysis within seconds of collection. This work supported the development of features that improved player retention by 15% through targeted in-game interventions.  

Ava’s contributions extend beyond her primary role, including the creation of a Kafka-based pipeline for anomaly detection in game server logs. This project reduced incident response time by 25% and was later adopted as a standard tool across the engineering team. She also developed a Terraform module for provisioning scalable data processing clusters, which streamlined infrastructure deployment and reduced onboarding time for new projects. Her involvement in open-source contributions includes maintaining a Python library for data validation, which has been integrated into several internal workflows.  

Ava holds a Master of Science in Data Science from the University of California, Berkeley, where she focused on machine learning applications in large-scale data systems. Her academic work included developing a framework for real-time data segmentation, which was later adapted for use in gaming analytics.  

Languages: English (native), German (fluent)  
Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer  

Ava has maintained a consistent focus on operational excellence, ensuring that data systems are not only robust but also adaptable to evolving business needs. Her approach to problem-solving is grounded in practicality, with an emphasis on building infrastructure that can scale without compromising performance or security. She believes that effective data engineering is about creating systems that empower teams to ask the right questions and find the answers efficiently.
